name: What is an ice and water shield?

mainEntity.name: What is an ice and water shield?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rubberized asphalt membrane applied under shingles at eaves, valleys, penetrations for leak protection against ice dams, wind-driven rain. Required in many codes.
